newsitem.title: FRANCE: Waigel-growth too weak to change German job trend. [CORRECTED 13:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Waigel-growth too weak to change German job trend. [CORRECTED 13:30 GMT]

text.p: German Finance Minister Theo Waigel said on Wednesday (corrects from Tuesday) that economic growth was too weak to allow for a trend chance in the unemployment situation.
"Growth is still too weak this year to see a change in the trend for unemployment," Waigel told a news conference after a Franco-German summit.
Waigel said earlier that he expected during 1997 about 2.5 percent economic growth in both Germany and France.
